# apt-policy

<!-- Generated by tools/gen-docs.sh from modules/components/apt-policy; do not edit. -->

The system files that bind the other drivers of apt (unattended-upgrades, the software updaters, a plain `apt upgrade`) to what `dotsteward upgrade` does with the kernel and driver classes. Linux only, method `system`.

The component lives in [`modules/components/apt-policy`](../../modules/components/apt-policy/):

- [README.md](../../modules/components/apt-policy/README.md): what it installs, its options and its settings.
- [maintenance.md](../../modules/components/apt-policy/maintenance.md): its pins and how `dotsteward-update` refreshes them.
- [default.nix](../../modules/components/apt-policy/default.nix): the Home Manager module that fills the component contract.
- [seed.json](../../modules/components/apt-policy/seed.json): the flake inputs and lock entries an instance starts with when it enables the component.

See the [catalog](../catalog.md) for the other components.
